  • Repository contents: acme-shop is a minimal Git repository containing only README.md and lib.rs (with no Cargo.toml or src/ directory).
  • Documentation: README.md:1 consists of a single heading (# acme-shop).
  • Library code: lib.rs:1 defines one public function, add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32, which returns a + b.
  • Direct rustc unit testing: Without a Cargo.toml, lib.rs can be tested by adding a #[cfg(test)] mod tests block and compiling with rustc --test lib.rs, then running the resulting test binary.
  • Cargo-based testing: Adding a Cargo.toml (pointing lib.path to lib.rs or moving it to src/lib.rs) enables running cargo test for both unit tests and doc-tests.
  • Test cases to cover: Tests for add should verify positive/negative/zero inputs as well as i32 boundary behavior (such as i32::MAX overflow panicking in debug mode or wrapping in release mode).
